description: floorboss: every MCP call to a tool floorboss has a recipe for must match the recipe, and a staged draft must match a message floorboss listed. Claude's own file tools never read keys or credentials, never write floorboss's records, and write only floorboss's data folder and the temp folder while a run is under way. While a run is under way, WebFetch opens only the sites floorboss has a reason to, and no web address or search query may be long or span lines. The guard fails closed: if it can't start, crashes or runs past its time, the call is blocked. After an MCP call has run, the guard records what it asked about (a lookup counted, a batch of drafts confirmed), so a no at a prompt stops the rest. The run lock is tied to the session that runs floorboss and ends with it. When the user reports what happened with outreach for a live event, Claude is reminded to record it in floorboss.
